children: Turkish military pension fund OYAK is in talks with a major global energy company over a strategic partnership in fuel distributor Guzel Enerji, with the outcome expected to become clear by early next year.
OYAK General Manager Murat Yalcintas did not name the potential partner, but OYAK has previously said it was holding talks with Saudi Arabia's state oil company Saudi Aramco
over a possible stake in Turkey's fourth largest fuel retailer Guzel Enerji.
OYAK's head of energy business Ugur Dogan, said in May that talks were under way for Aramco to become a shareholder in Guzel Enerji.
Yalcintas said OYAK wants to expand its energy activities beyond fuel distribution into production and refining as part of its 2030 strategy to become an international player in core sectors.
He said the partnership under discussion would be an important step in OYAK's push to build a more multinational structure.
On a planned refinery investment, Yalcintas said OYAK was considering both greenfield projects and opportunities involving existing refineries, either in Turkey or abroad.
